# ANALYSIS: shotgun_scalper_stage4_keeper_top

**Filed:** 2026-07-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The top keeper from shotgun_scalper_stage4 attempts to capture edge through aggressive profit-taking (75% TP) and tight stops (35% premium stop) combined with OTM-2 strikes and volume filtering. The hypothesis is that this setup exploits short-term mean reversion in premium after initial adverse moves, but risks missing J's structural winners due to premature exits.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Triggered when premium moves against position by 35% (stop) OR time stop at 12 minutes OR volume ratio exceeds 1.2x baseline.  
**Exit:** Take profit at 75% premium gain; otherwise stop at 35% loss or 12-minute time stop. Uses OTM-2 strikes (strike_offset=2) and chandelier profit-lock arms at 60% gain.  
**State:** No additional filters; relies purely on premium-based triggers and time/volume constraints.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Backtest assumes qty suitable for $25K+ account (e.g., 28 contracts at ~$2.00 entry premium). $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L ($3,091.79 vs $22,084.20).
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size = 16 months (~345 trading days), 1,199 trades. Selection method = in-sample grinder optimization over entire period without walk-forward. Overfit risk = high due to multi-stage selection without OOS validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window performed in Stage 4 output).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no validation of top 3 J days against real OPRA fills; BS-sim used).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day = -$195.45 (2026-05-15); max drawdown unknown without equity curve; blow-up scenario = consecutive losses triggering 35% stops repeatedly (e.g., 10 losses = ~350% of risked premium per trade).
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days = 13.9% of P&L (top5_pct=0.139), indicating low concentration risk.

## Pre-merge gate

Requires: (1) OOS walk-forward with edge_capture > 771 (OP-16 floor), (2) real-fills validation on top 3 J days showing <20% P&L deviation from BS-sim, (3) walk-forward Sharpe > 0.70, (4) sub-window stability (no single quarter >50% of P&L).

## Confidence

3 / 10 -- Edge_capture (506.55) is below OP-16 floor (771), indicating failure to capture J's edge. Strategy makes money on loser days (5/06, 5/07) and underperforms on winner days, suggesting misalignment with structural bias. High overfit risk from aggressive parameter search.
